창세기_1_1.verseText: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

표1_원어분석.설교포인트: Everything created has a beginning, but God already was before any beginning.

표1_원어분석.의미_문법: God / plural form with singular verb
표1_원어분석.설교포인트: The mystery of the Trinity is already hinted within the one God.
Both the visible sky and the unseen spiritual realm are created.
This earth is not chance, but a planned work of God.

표2_역사적배경.내용: The Babylonian Enuma Elish tells of the world born from conflict among the gods; Scripture proclaims creation by the one God.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Emphasize the uniqueness and trustworthiness of the Bible.

표2_역사적배경.내용: Bereshit is linked with wisdom (Prov 8:22); the Targum renders it in connection with the Word.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Connect this to Christ, the Word.

표2_역사적배경.내용: Mesopotamian tablets (Gilgamesh) preserve similar flood and origin memories.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Ancient memory is shared, yet only Scripture is strictly monotheistic.

표3_신학적의미.설명: Creation from nothing (creatio ex nihilo); the world exists by God’s will.
As Creator, God holds absolute authority over all creation.
Elohim (plural) with a singular verb; the Spirit moves (v. 2); creation by the Word (v. 3).

표4_예표론.내용: The first creation is a pattern of new creation: from chaos to order, darkness to light.
John reinterprets “in the beginning” with the Word who was with God.
All things were created through Him and for Him.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: The first verse of the Bible gives us a satisfying account of the origin of the universe.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: The opening verse of Scripture gives a satisfying account of the origin of the universe.
표5_매튜헨리.Key Insight: God’s existence is proclaimed, not proved.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: We have here the work of creation and the author of that work.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: Here we see both the work of creation and the Author of that work.
표5_매튜헨리.Key Insight: Creation is God’s first act of revealing His glory.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: By faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: By faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God.
표5_매튜헨리.Key Insight: When creation is received by faith, the door to every truth opens.

표6_설교자료.내용: The God of the beginning is the God of today
Many theories seek the origin of the universe, yet Scripture begins, “In the beginning God…”
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: Science asks how; Scripture answers who and why.

표6_설교자료.내용: The eternal God exists before time as Creator.
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: The maker of a clock stands outside the clock.

표6_설교자료.내용: He creates from nothing—the Almighty who makes the impossible possible.
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: A testimony of a new path opened in despair.

표6_설교자료.내용: Creation has purpose; every creature is made within God’s will.
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: Why parents bring a child into the world.

표6_설교자료.내용: The God of the beginning still creates today.

표7_찬송가.제목: O Come, Let Us Adore Him / Praise Him with Joy
표7_찬송가.선정이유: A classic hymn of praise to the Creator God.

표7_찬송가.제목: The Spacious Firmament / High Blue Heavens
표7_찬송가.선정이유: Praise to the God who made the heavens.
Praise to Christ, Maker of all things.
A hymn that exalts the name of the Creator.

표8_상담적용.성경원리: You are not an accident but God’s creation.

표8_상담적용.실제적용: Past failure is not the end.
Even in confusion, the Creator remains Sovereign.

표9_교차참조.연결점: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made.
I made the earth and created humankind upon it.
O Lord, how manifold are Your works!
The Lord made the earth by His power.
In the beginning was the Word; all things were made through Him.
All things were created in Him.
By faith we understand that the universe was formed by God’s word.
You created all things.

창세기_1_2.verseText: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

표1_원어분석.설교포인트: Without God, life is shapeless and empty of meaning.
The emptiness of the soul is filled only by God’s presence.
Introduce God’s light over against the darkness of sin.
Even in deep turmoil, God works sovereignly.
Connect the Spirit’s hovering with creation and new creation.

표2_역사적배경.내용: Mesopotamian and Ugaritic texts tell of gods conquering chaotic seas.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Contrast Scripture’s God who creates by the Word, not by combat.

표2_역사적배경.내용: Creation faith was handed to the wilderness community after the Exodus.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Teach pilgrims in chaos to trust the Creator.

표2_역사적배경.내용: A three-tiered world of heaven–earth–sea; the Spirit moves over the deep.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Understand the ancient worldview as a bridge for modern conversation.

표3_신학적의미.설명: God brings order from nothing (creatio ex nihilo).
The Holy Spirit actively participates in the work of creation.
Even chaos and emptiness remain under God’s rule.

표4_예표론.내용: The Spirit hovering over chaos links to the dove after the flood.
표4_예표론.그리스도연결: The Spirit descending at Christ’s baptism
In Christ, chaos is re-created into order.

표4_예표론.내용: Christ as the Word (Logos) who was with God from the beginning.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: The Spirit of God was the first mover.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: The Spirit of God was the first mover.
표5_매튜헨리.Key Insight: The power of creation is the Holy Spirit.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: Chaos makes way for cosmos when God speaks.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: When God speaks, chaos becomes cosmos.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: Darkness serves to magnify the light that follows.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: Darkness serves to magnify the light that follows.
표5_매튜헨리.Key Insight: The principle of glory after trial.

표6_설교자료.예화_적용: An artist turning a blank canvas into a masterpiece

표6_설교자료.내용: Face the chaos and emptiness of our lives.

표6_설교자료.예화_적용: A satellite lost against the night sky

표6_설교자료.내용: Presence over chaos—the Spirit moves even in darkness.
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: A single light after a blackout
A mother bird brooding an egg about to hatch

표6_설교자료.내용: When life is yielded to the Spirit, chaos becomes calling.

표7_찬송가.선정이유: Praise for the greatness of creation.

표7_찬송가.제목: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
표7_찬송가.선정이유: Apply the Spirit’s comfort and hovering care.

표8_상담적용.성경원리: Bohu (emptiness) is filled by God’s presence.
표8_상담적용.실제적용: Urge Scripture meditation and gathered worship.

표8_상담적용.상황: A young adult who has lost direction
표8_상담적용.성경원리: The Spirit (ruach) brings order by hovering.
표8_상담적용.실제적용: Guide them to seek the Spirit’s leading in prayer.

표8_상담적용.성경원리: Even darkness (choshekh) is within God’s plan.
표8_상담적용.실제적용: Coach them to retell failure as testimony.

표9_교차참조.연결점: The Spirit renews the face of the earth.
Reuse of the language of formless and void.
By His Spirit the heavens are garnished.
He did not create the earth a waste.
The Word (Logos) and creation.
God shines light out of darkness.
All things created through Christ.
Behold, I make all things new.

창세기_1_3.verseText: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

표1_원어분석.설교포인트: The command form calls for immediate obedience.

표1_원어분석.의미_문법: God / plural form with singular sense

표2_역사적배경.항목: Light in the Ancient Near East
표2_역사적배경.내용: Contrasts with myths centered on sun gods.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Guard against worship of created things.

표2_역사적배경.내용: The pillar of fire guided by light.
표2_역사적배경.목회적활용: Connect to guidance by the Word.

표2_역사적배경.내용: Forming the identity of the Exodus community.

표3_신학적의미.설명: Existence comes into being by the Word.

표4_예표론.그리스도연결: Salvation under the blood in darkness

표4_예표론.내용: The Word who has shone from the beginning.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: God's word created the first daybreak.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: God's word created the first daybreak.
표5_매튜헨리.Key Insight: The creative power of the Word.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: No creature can resist His fiat.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: No creature can resist His command.

표5_매튜헨리.English Original: Light is the first blessing He bestows.
표5_매튜헨리.English Explanation: Light is the first blessing He bestows.

표6_설교자료.내용: Let there be light!—the Word that pierces chaos
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: One flashlight changing a dark room

표6_설교자료.대지: Point 1: God’s voice that opens creation
표6_설교자료.내용: The power of the Word—God’s speech begins creation.

표6_설교자료.대지: Point 3: The gospel shining on my life today
표6_설교자료.예화_적용: Light at the end of a tunnel

표8_상담적용.성경원리: Set direction by following the light.

표9_교차참조.연결점: Your word is a lamp.
Arise, shine.
The dwelling of light.
The sun of righteousness.
The light of the world.
Light shining in darkness.
Children of light.
Eternal light.
